This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
BETTER_STACK_SOURCE_TOKEN required secret Better Stack states no sensitivity anywhere, so this is secret here. Its own Next.js sample does put the same token in the browser under a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name; that spelling is not offered, because one token used both places is exposed for both if it is exposed at all.. where to get it
